# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read and follow **AGENTS.md** in the repository root. It is the canonical
source of engineering standards.

## Requirements

- Preserve existing application behaviour.
- Use the configured Prettier formatter and ESLint linter.
- Follow the import ordering and naming conventions in AGENTS.md.
- Do not introduce `any` types.
- Do not refactor architecture beyond the current task scope.
- Use **npm** as the package manager.
